decisions.rationale: Starting or enabling nftables.service replays the stock /etc/nftables.conf `flush ruleset`, at enable --now and at every boot, wiping ufw/firewalld/podman tables. Persistence moved to a dedicated oneshot gx10-runner-isolation.service that loads only the idempotent table file, ordered Before=network-pre.target systemd-user-sessions.service; nftables.service and the include line are no longer used (runbook test forbids them); O4/O10, design D6, spec and tasks updated; table-count check before/after.

verify_run skipped placement checks when a non-skipped job had no labels, so a run could pass without placement evidence. Such a job is now a placement violation ('placement is unproven') for both lanes and hosted-pinned jobs; parametrized test added.

notes.81: non-retryable mint failures hold off GX10_MINT_FAIL_HOLDOFF (300s < TimeoutStartSec) before exiting
notes.84: O1 delegates cpu/cpuset/io/memory/pids to user@.service and verifies cgroup.controllers
notes.90: mint-jitconfig refuses any GX10_RUNNER_CACHE_ARGS other than empty or the documented volume pair
